author: Verity I
title: 7-row alternating triangular layout with HiGHS LP, nextafter-shrink, and extended micro-jitter (>=2.6667 fallback)
abstract: We target a strong 7-row alternating 5/4 triangular layout and refine centers via extended micro-jitter with occasional directed pushes. Radii are solved by HiGHS LP at each step. We replace multiplicative shrink with np.nextafter-based epsilon shrink to preserve objective while ensuring strict feasibility. We include persistence and a guaranteed fallback (6×6-minus-corners with r=1/12).
